07 . This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Though this matter has been listed under the heading "For Orders" regarding non-deposit of differential deficit court fee by the Appellant No.3, it came to the notice of the Court that inadvertently, in 4th Paragraph of the order dated 02.04.2024, it was observed/ordered that "
xxx......But the Stamp Reporter has calculated the delay in presenting the Memorandum of Appeal incorrectly as per the old Act, 1894.

Hence, office is also directed to do the stamp reporting correctly with regard to delay in presenting the Memorandum of Appeal before the next date of listing".
3.
Hence, the above observation/expression in 4th Paragraph of the order dated 02.04.2024 be deleted.
The rest part of the order dated 02.04.2024 shall remain unaltered.
4. Mr. Mohanty, learned Counsel for the Appellants undertakes to deposit the differential deficit court fee of Rs.583.45 in course of the day, so far as Appellant No.3 is concerned.

5. Since the issue regarding condonation of delay beyond 120 days (60+60) under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, is now sub- judice before the apex Court, matter be listed in the week commencing from 29th July,
2024 for consideration of application for condonation of delay.
